text_block_list.text:
The "Spirit, Technique, Legs" Strongest Tournament to decide
the cover girl for the Tracen Academy applicant brochure...
Many girls cleared the "Spirit" stage.

In the subsequent stage competing in "Technique,"
I heard Gentildonna was going to battle, and when I went to watch out of curiosity—a massive crowd had gathered.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I heard we get to decide the winner next!
Apparently we vote for whichever dancer feels the "strongest"!
choice_data_list: (So the "Technique" stage is a dance battle...)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I mean... I'm so excited~! 
Seeing those two face off is way too rare...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Let us begin.
Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Then allow me to go first.
—Feast your eyes upon the dance of the strongest.

Gentildonna danced with sheer elegance... and yet, 
every subtle movement radiated tremendous power. 
As I watched, wondering if this was truly her idea of "strength"—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hahhhh!!!!
(*THUDDD...!!*)

—With a thunderous stomp, 
Gentildonna soared high... 
soaring into the air...!
choice_data_list: (T-This truly is the dance of the strongest...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Now, it is your turn.
Duramente-san?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna-san was incredible...
Duramente-san's gotta be just as insane~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
She's aiming to be the strongest too, right?
Plus, she's an ultra-elite! 
She's definitely going to show us something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Duramente-san,
why don't you step down from the stage?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You seem unwell.
If you were to stumble on stage,
it might tarnish the reputation of your bloodline.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You seem aware of it yourself, so...
allow me to escort you down below.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to feel bad.
Even if you profess to be the strongest...
whether you possess the "right" to claim it is another matter entirely. Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
............
No. I will dance.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The right to the title of the strongest... lies within this blood.
And I shall prove it through dance.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...If you insist that far,
then by all means, do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Not a single flaw.
Indeed, that too is—a form of strength.

Duramente had also demonstrated a form of ultimate strength through dance: "Perfection."
And the showdown between these two masters of "Skill"—

Concluded with Duramente "withdrawing"
from the tournament.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna was likely trying to...
bring out my full power.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I do not know why. However...
she is also someone of pride.
She wished to clash with all our might.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I will not accept a result achieved through her preparation.
Next time... I will claim victory solely by my own power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
She too holds her own definition of the strongest.
...Fufu, fascinating after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy... An academy of the strong, where those
possessing diverse powers gather and hone themselves.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The final stage... a showdown of "Legs."
I wonder who shall be waiting to greet me—
